statusSub.balanced: Khii, Shar and Badgan are in balance. Keep up your current routine.
statusSub.khii_excess: Khii (Wind) is dominant. Warmth and rest are needed.
statusSub.shar_badgan_excess: Shar (Fire) or Badgan (Earth) is dominant. A diet plan and cooling exercise are needed.

noRemedyBody: A new calculation creates remedies automatically

khii.title: When Khii (Wind) is dominant
khii.body: Warm food, clear oil and rest are essential. Stay away from cold, dry surroundings.

balanced.title: When balanced
balanced.body: Keep up your current routine. Make small adjustments as the seasons change.

sharBadgan.title: When Shar/Badgan is dominant
sharBadgan.body: Eat light food and exercise; avoid heavy, moist food.

disclaimer: Consult a qualified practitioner before following these recommendations.
